summary_md: **まぷて ([@mapte_fireball](https://x.com/mapte_fireball/status/2116015400387596455))** shares **StableGen 0.4.0**, a free open Blender add-on connecting Qwen Image 2.1 and TRELLIS.2 via ComfyUI for text-to-mesh, texturing, auto-rigging and applying FBX/BVH motion with Unreal export, demoed on an RTX 4080 (Qwen Image 2.1 is non-commercial) ([sakalond/StableGen](https://github.com/sakalond/StableGen), [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion/comments/1xiolct/qwen_image_21_trellis2_in_blender_from_a_prompt/)).
